annotations.title: Check the app before a build

description: Checks this Expo app for what App Store Connect and Google Play would reject, before spending time on a build (a Flutter, React Native, Capacitor, Gradle or Xcode app, which Ploa builds too, isn't checked yet: it says so, and the build can go ahead): version and build numbers against the stores, bundle IDs, the icon, iOS purpose strings, privacy manifest, export compliance, Play's target SDK, sensitive permissions, and secrets committed to git. Returns each finding with how to fix it.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
